newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian nuclear energy minister visits China.
newsitem.headline: Russian nuclear energy minister visits China.

text.p: Atomic Energy Minister Viktor Mikhailov, keen to sell nuclear technology abroad, visits China this week to attend the opening of part of a plant to produce enriched uranium.
Itar-Tass news agency said on Wednesday Mikhailov would attend talks aimed at speeding up the construction of a new Chinese nuclear power plant, which would use two Russian-designed reactors.
Each reactor, being sold at prices "not below those on the world market" would cost around $1.5-$2 billion, although some of the Russian work was being done on credit, Tass said.
Russia and China agreed last April to cooperate in the field of civilian nuclear energy and described the uranium enrichment plant and the power station as two key projects.
The two countries will also work together on the conversion of defence sector plants for civilian use.
